author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Consent Gap
challenge.description: A new model version requires loyalty basket data, but the deployment pipeline lacks the governance controls to verify consent. #automation_alex# wants to push the automated deployment forward immediately to meet the promotion deadline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a manual review process to ensure legal compliance. #automation_alex# is open to adding a manual approval step if it keeps the pipeline moving, but #requirements_reuben# will not accept any automated path without full audit trails.

output.content: The deployment pipeline must have full audit trails for any automated path. I will not accept any automated deployment without a full audit trail that proves consent was checked. This is a hard line. If the system cannot log every consent verification step before the model goes live, the release stops. There is no workaround. We do not trade compliance for speed. The legal duty to protect personal data is non negotiable. Until the pipeline can demonstrate that every loyalty basket record used in training was accessed with valid, verifiable consent, the automated path remains closed. I am not open to partial logging or manual spot checks. The audit trail must be complete and immutable. This is the condition for my sign off, and it does not move.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly defines a non-negotiable line where the absence of a complete audit trail results in the refusal to sign off, with no room for trade-offs or partial compliance.
